package rulefixtures

import "errors"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_error_handling_cost_sentinel_error_allocated_per_call: Layer: Error handling cost. Flag identical sentinel errors allocated inside functions instead of package-level variables.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func FindUser(id int) (string, error) {
	if id <= 0 {
		return "", errors.New("not found")
	}
	if id > 10000 {
		return "", errors.New("not found")
	}
	return "user_" + string(rune(id)), nil
}

func LookupProduct(sku string) (string, error) {
	if sku == "" {
		return "", errors.New("not found")
	}
	return "product_" + sku, nil
}
